title: Immaculate Conception Cathedral, Comayagua
geometryBasis: Named cathedral way 310133177 fixes the southwest wall and east and northwest perimeter. The model partitions the compound into sanctuary, single north tower, north courtyard gate, attached chapels and chapter range. Its exposed north courtyard remains open.
sectionBasis: Original Terrarium elevations fix the plaza contact and rising east ground. The municipality documents the single four-stage clock tower, five domes and carved west frontage. The IHAH archaeology and Mario Felipe Martínez's study document the arrangement of the aisles, courtyard, sacristy and chapel. Crown, stage divisions, individual drapery and most roof heights are estimates.
limitations: Public-domain 1859 engraving guides the plaza elevation and south wall. Present clock placement, five domes, relief motifs and the open north patio follow the documented standing cathedral.

The native mapped perimeter and original elevation field fix scale, orientation and grade. The division of the rear chapel and chapter ranges, the paving, the exact thresholds and individual section heights are estimates.

Model scope is the cathedral exterior. The carved saints and heraldic and botanical relief are simplified silhouettes at landmark scale; the historic atrium railing in the engraving is outside the standing exterior scope.
